location.basis: Centre of the mound read on the imagery at about 29.3647 N, 67.5881 E, matching the published position 29.365 N, 67.588 E (Wikipedia and OpenStreetMap).

main_system_reason: No system: we found no measurable Harappan line.
notes: The Esri imagery is a Vantor Vivid mosaic of 2 August 2025 with real detail to zoom 18 (0.52 m per pixel). The mound is a low scrub-covered rise on the bank of a dry channel, surrounded by a grid of field embankments; the French excavations of 1985-1996 are not visible as exposed walls. The straight lines in the scene are field embankments. Nausharo is not measurable from this imagery.
